caseNameFull: Sims v. Moore, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Fla. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied without prejudice in light of the Supreme Court of Florida’s order, case No. 96,818, granting a temporary stay to and including 7:00 a.m. on Tuesday, November 2, 1999.
